name: com.albertelias.simple-xr-device-simulator
description: Test an XR Interaction Toolkit scene in the Unity Editor with a mouse or trackpad and a keyboard. The mouse acts as one controller and works with the interactables and UI already in your scene.

samples.description: A table, a cube to grab, a Reset button and three teleport spots, with the controls already in the scene and listed on a panel. Open the scene and press Play.
